title: What if I watch half of the next one?
scene: 看动画片到点，他谈条件、自己定规则。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: What if I watch half of the next one?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Just one more, then I turn it off.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'll set a timer this time.

variations: "episode" 换 "song"；"set a timer" 换 "count to fifty"。
